accepted_scope: Offline pure-renderer contract on actual frozen source; not database, engine, init-hook, filesystem-permission, or world acceptance
limitations: Actual MariaDB parsing, executed row readback, fresh-database init-hook ordering and execution remain pending; no database acceptance is inferred from regex/byte checks.
Mount integration, container UID ownership and private SQL file permissions remain pending. The pure renderer returns bytes and cannot establish correct file modes.
Hex literals encode plaintext sensitive credentials; they neither encrypt nor redact them.
Not a migration, reset, existing-world repair, launch authority, or world-initialization result.
Compose/native integration and combined project gates are outside this independent review.
